name: dw-solo
description: The thin lane, for your own projects. One artifact per change instead of three, one quality pass instead of five. Skills: dw-init (scaffold a solo repo), dw-grill (bounded interview, one question at a time), dw-shape (one CHANGE.md with a task checklist), dw-next (resume point and build step in one), dw-land (verdict, then promote decisions and drop the scaffolding). Install this instead of dw-planning + dw-quality — not alongside them.
